media.title: Rudolf Walther-Fein — portrait photograph
media.altText: Black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of film director Rudolf Walther-Fein wearing a light suit and holding a pipe.
media.publicCaption: Rudolf Walther-Fein (1875–1933), Austrian film director and producer.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer, date and original publication unidentified; reproduced from the Rudolf Walther-Fein photo page at Kino-Teatr.Ru.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. Kino-Teatr.Ru identifies the sitter as Rudolf Walther-Fein but does not provide the photographer, date, original publication or an open licence. The unchanged 471 × 570 pixel image is used at limited resolution for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator, with the available source page and unresolved attribution stated alongside it.
